entities.summary: Kizhi is an island near the geometrical center of Lake Onega in the Republic of Karelia, Russia. It is elongated from north to south and is about 6 kilometres (3.7 mi) long, 1 kilometre (0.62 mi) wide and is about 68 kilometres (42 mi) away from the capital of Karelia, Petrozavodsk.
